instruction: Update the first paragraph to use a 14-point font size and save your changes.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the font size of the first paragraph to 14 points. The evaluator checks if all runs in the first paragraph have font size 14. Custom getter reads the DOCX file and extracts font sizes for the specified paragraph.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts font sizes from all runs in the DOCX file's first paragraph
Metric properly uses expected parameter (directly accessing rules dict, not expected.get('rules'))
Comparison logic appropriately checks all runs have font size 14pt with reasonable tolerance (0.1pt)
Expected values are semantically correct: paragraph_index=0 for first paragraph, font_size=14 matches instruction
File retrieval from VM implicitly verifies the document was saved (getter would fail if file not saved)
Postconfig includes 1-second sleep to allow document save to complete
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor edge case: Getter only collects runs with explicit font.size set - runs using default font size won't be verified. Consider handling runs without explicit font size.
Minor edge case: Empty paragraph (no runs) returns 0.0. While reasonable for this task, consider if this is the desired behavior.
